# om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100

Several official filenames appear upstream; advertised version alone is not byte identity.

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md). **Advertised version:** 1.1. **Internal build:** 1100.

**Container SHA-256:** not recorded in this entry.

Several official filenames appear upstream; advertised version alone is not byte identity.

## Technical reference

- [Only call code in a section that has already loaded](../reference/hazard.section-load-order.md): Sections load one after another; a hook calling a later section can run before its target exists.
- [fclose](../reference/om3-1100.fclose.md): Stock file close on the memory card.
- [fopen](../reference/om3-1100.fopen.md): Stock file open on the memory card.
- [fread](../reference/om3-1100.fread.md): Stock file read from the memory card.
- [free](../reference/om3-1100.free.md): Stock heap free, the counterpart of malloc.
- [Half-press hook](../reference/om3-1100.half-press-hook.md): A shutter half-press path used to run code once the card is ready.
- [Hue/lightness builder call site](../reference/om3-1100.hue-lightness-call.md): Where the colour stage calls the hue/lightness builder; Caduceus hooks here.
- [malloc](../reference/om3-1100.malloc.md): Stock heap allocator, class 1 pool.
- [Settings getter (active profile)](../reference/om3-1100.profile-getter.md): Stock settings getter; with setting 63153 it returns the active colour profile.
- [Section 1 free tail](../reference/om3-1100.section-1-tail.md): Unused 0xFF bytes at the end of section 1, which loads first.
